question: How can a reality contestant be shown saying a sentence they never said?
answer: By a frankenbite: editors join words recorded at different moments, even in answer to different questions, into one line. A cutaway shot covers the join so the mouth is not seen. Story editors, who shape unscripted shows much as writers shape scripted ones, use it to build arguments a season needs.
move: Treat any quote you cannot hear in full as an assembly.
ask: Which quote did I accept today that I never heard in full?
reference: Jennifer L. Pozner, Reality Bites Back: The Troubling Truth About Guilty Pleasure TV, Seal Press, 2010
